newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Average rate 4.10 pct on Swedish 3-month T-bill.
newsitem.headline: Average rate 4.10 pct on Swedish 3-month T-bill.

text.p: The average accepted rate in an auction of three-month Treasury bills was 4.10 percent and for a six-month paper 4.19 percent, Sweden's National Debt Office said on Wednesday.

The office had invited bids for a total of 4.5 billion crowns of three and six-month papers. It received 22 bids for the three-month bill and accepted six. For the six-month paper it received 46 bids and accepted 26.
Both maturities were oversubscribed with the office receiving bids totalling 10.8 billion crowns -- 3.4 billion crowns for the three-month paper and 7.4 billion for the six-month paper.
